title: Exchange Rate Determination for Cryptocurrency Mergers: A Formal Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.39264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many of the thousands of existing cryptocurrencies suffer from declining adoption, low liquidity and weak security, and merging two of them into a single ecosystem is a natural alternative to abandonment. No rigorous framework exists, however, for determining a fair exchange rate in such a merger. Unlike that of a corporation, the value of a cryptocurrency is driven by network effects, so the exchange rate itself influences the value of the merged asset. We extend the exchange-ratio framework of Mainini, Moretto and Visetti [7] by making the merged value endogenous: the exchange rate determines community migration, migration determines (up to user overlap) the post-merger network state, and an axiomatised valuation function assigns a value to that state. translated_title: 加密货币合并中的汇率决定：一个形式化框架
translated_abstract: 现存的数千种加密货币中，许多都面临着采用率下降、流动性低和安全性弱的问题，将其中两个合并为单一生态系统是放弃它们的自然替代方案。然而，目前尚无严谨的框架来确定此类合并中的公平汇率。与公司不同，加密货币的价值由网络效应驱动，因此汇率本身会影响合并后资产的价值。我们通过使合并价值内生化，扩展了Mainini、Moretto和Visetti [7]的兑换比率框架：汇率决定社区迁移，迁移决定（在考虑用户重叠的前提下）合并后的网络状态，再由一个公理化的估值函数为该状态赋予价值。由此产生的协同效应没有预设的正负方向，且议价区域的边界在汇率上变得自指。我们证明了不存在任何使合并……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个确定加密货币合并公平汇率的严谨形式化框架，其核心创新在于将合并后价值内生化——汇率决定社区迁移并进而影响合并后网络估值，并证明了协同效应方向不定且议价区间边界对汇率具有自指性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first rigorous formal framework for determining fair exchange rates in cryptocurrency mergers, with the key innovation of making the merged value endogenous—where the exchange rate drives community migration and thus post-merger network valuation—and proves that the synergy sign is indeterminate and the bargaining region's bounds are self-referential in the exchange rate.
